prose: Raindrop, which builds monitoring technology for AI agents to catch failures such as hallucinations, raised a $35 million Series A led by CRV, co-founders Zubin Koticha and Ben Hylak told Axios Pro exclusively. The full terms are behind the Axios Pro paywall; the disclosed facts confirm the round size, the lead investor and Raindrop's focus on agent-monitoring infrastructure as enterprises deploy AI agents into production.
highlights: Raindrop raised a $35M Series A led by CRV
Co-founders Zubin Koticha and Ben Hylak disclosed the round to Axios Pro
Raindrop builds monitoring tech to catch AI agent failures such as hallucinations
